name: search-by-code-owner
description: Search files by code ownership using CODEOWNERS file from GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, and Bitbucket

languageModelTools.name: codeOwner_listFiles
languageModelTools.userDescription: List workspace files assigned to a concrete CODEOWNER.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return workspace file paths assigned to the exact concrete CODEOWNER supplied in owner according to CODEOWNERS. Preserve the owner string exactly; never substitute another owner based on a file path or a previous request. Unowned files are not supported. Each result includes the file's resolved owners and matching CODEOWNERS pattern. Results can optionally exclude .gitignore and VS Code excluded files.

owner.description: The exact concrete CODEOWNER requested, such as @org/team. Preserve this value exactly. Do not use Unowned or Owned by all.

excludeGitIgnore.description: Exclude files matched by .gitignore. Defaults to true.

useVscodeExcludes.description: Exclude files hidden by VS Code files.exclude or search.exclude settings. Defaults to true.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of files to return. Defaults to 1000.

languageModelTools.name: codeOwner_searchFiles
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search the contents of files assigned to a concrete CODEOWNER.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return files assigned to the exact concrete CODEOWNER supplied in owner whose contents match a query. Preserve the owner string exactly; never substitute another owner based on a file path or a previous request. Supports case sensitivity, regular expressions, and whole-word matching. Each result includes the file's resolved owners and matching CODEOWNERS pattern. Unowned files are not supported.

owner.description: The exact concrete CODEOWNER requested, such as @org/team. Preserve this value exactly. Do not use Unowned or Owned by all.

query.description: Text or regular expression to find in file contents.

caseSensitive.description: Match letter case exactly. Defaults to false.

isRegex.description: Treat query as a JavaScript regular expression. Defaults to false.

matchWholeWord.description: Require word boundaries around a match. Defaults to false.

excludeGitIgnore.description: Exclude files matched by .gitignore. Defaults to true.

useVscodeExcludes.description: Exclude files hidden by VS Code files.exclude or search.exclude settings. Defaults to true.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching files to return. Defaults to 1000.

languageModelTools.name: codeOwner_findMatchingOwners
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find CODEOWNERS owners whose names match a partial string, even without the org prefix.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return canonical CODEOWNERS owners whose full names, org segments, or local team names contain the supplied partial owner query. Matching is case-insensitive and accepts values such as network, semconv-network, or @open-telemetry/semconv-network-approvers. Results are sorted and can be truncated by maxResults.

query.description: Partial owner text to match against CODEOWNERS owners, such as network, semconv-network, or @open-telemetry/semconv-network-approvers.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of owners to return. Defaults to 1000.

codeOwner.experimental.multiRootWorkspac.markdownDescription: **(Experimental)** When you open a `.code-workspace` file with multiple folders, or a single folder whose path is not the workspace file directory (for example `./subFolder`), resolve CODEOWNERS from the workspace file directory and rewrite search include/exclude patterns to match VS Code Search roots (including renamed folders).

scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
